tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return the curated FEATURED skills (handpicked best-of) followed by all categories. Call this first when starting a new task. YOU (the LLM agent) are the librarian. The catalog is static and deterministic — there is no server-side ranker. Recommended flow: (1) read MCP resource skillport://featured to scan handpicked best skills; (2) if nothing fits, read skillport://categories then skillport://category/<id> for the full list; (3) optionally call preview_skill to read the SKILL.md body before installing; (4) call install_skill once you've decided. Use search_skill only when free-text intent isn't covered by browsing.

tools.name: list_featured
tools.description: Return ONLY the handpicked featured skills, grouped by section. Faster than list_categories when you need a quick recommendation. The user's LLM agent should pick from this list whenever possible — these are pre-vetted.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List skills in a given category (or all skills if omitted). Use after list_categories when you've picked a category id (e.g. 'frontend', 'video-editing', 'ui-design', 'mobile').

category.description: Category id from list_categories. Omit to list every skill (capped by `limit`).

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Fetch full structured metadata for one skill: description, tags, recommended_npm, source_repo, license, trust_tier. Does NOT include the SKILL.md body — use preview_skill for that.

tools.name: preview_skill
tools.description: Read the actual SKILL.md body (first N lines) WITHOUT installing. Use this to confirm a skill fits the user's task before calling install_skill — saves you from installing then realizing it's wrong.

tools.name: search_skill
tools.description: Free-text BM25 search across the catalog with tag/framework boosts. Pass `category` to scope to one category. Prefer browsing via resources/list_categories — only use search when intent is hard to name.

category.description: Optional category id to restrict the search.

tools.name: install_skill
tools.description: Install a skill into .claude/skills/<name>/ so Claude Code auto-detects it next turn. Verifies Ed25519 signature when present (local registry skills are unsigned and skipped with an info log). `scope=project` writes to cwd, `scope=user` writes to ~/.claude/skills.

tools.name: list_installed
tools.description: List skills currently installed in this project and user-wide. Reports name, version, category, scope, path.
